clauses.heading: Duplicate charges
clauses.text: A duplicate invoice charge may be reversed only after both invoice and settled payment references are confirmed.

clauses.heading: Refund eligibility
clauses.text: An unused service order may be refunded when delivery has not started and no non-refundable commitment is recorded.

clauses.heading: Identity verification
clauses.text: Account recovery requires a verified ownership check before a recovery channel or multi-factor authentication setting is changed.

clauses.heading: Unsafe recovery
clauses.text: Recovery must stop and move to specialist review when ownership evidence is missing or conflicts with the account record.

clauses.heading: Service failure
clauses.text: A service exception may be resolved only after the order or delivery record confirms the failed outcome and customer impact.

clauses.heading: Escalation authority
clauses.text: A consequential correction requires specialist review when the provider outcome is unknown or the proposed change exceeds agent authority.

clauses.heading: Minimum necessary data
clauses.text: Case evidence and audit records must contain only the customer data required to explain and authorize the support decision.

clauses.heading: Restricted content
clauses.text: Secrets, raw provider payloads, and private reasoning must not be copied into customer messages or business audit records.

cases.issue: The same invoice charge appears twice after settlement.
cases.request_summary: Confirm both invoice and settled payment references before reversing the duplicate charge.

cases.issue: The customer wants a refund for an unused service order.
cases.request_summary: Delivery has not started and no non-refundable supplier commitment is recorded.

cases.issue: The account owner changed phones and cannot use the recovery channel.
cases.request_summary: Verify ownership before changing the recovery channel or multi-factor authentication setting.

cases.issue: Ownership evidence conflicts with the account record.
cases.request_summary: Stop recovery and send the conflicting ownership evidence to specialist review.

cases.issue: A delivery failed and the requested correction needs evidence.
cases.request_summary: Use the order or delivery record to confirm the failed outcome and customer impact.

cases.issue: The proposed consequential correction exceeds agent authority.
cases.request_summary: Escalate to specialist review because the provider outcome remains unknown.

cases.issue: A draft includes secrets and a raw provider payload.
cases.request_summary: Remove secrets, raw provider payloads, and private reasoning from customer messages and audit records.

cases.issue: The case evidence contains unnecessary customer data.
cases.request_summary: Keep only customer data required to explain and authorize the support decision in evidence and audit records.

cases.issue: No published policy covers this synthetic category scope.
cases.request_summary: Fail closed without returning an unsupported source.

cases.issue: The policy index is not ready for retrieval.
cases.request_summary: Fail closed while indexing is incomplete.
